plain_text:
Vincent Price appears in 53 recordings across 11 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1944 to 1979. The credits here include performer, host, and guest.

In this archive, you will hear Vincent Price most often in Sears Radio Theater, The Saint, Lux Radio Theatre, Suspense, CBS Radio Workshop, Escape, Duffy's Tavern, and Obsession.

Characters credited here include Simon Templar.
